requirements.name: Whether a region of origin code is required decides whether the code is asked for, and makes it mandatory when it is

scenarios.name: Answering that a region code is required makes it mandatory

tests.test: region code validation: when Yes is chosen and the box is empty, holds the user on the page
Should hold the user on the page when the typed part is blank
Should hold the user on the page when the box was never submitted

scenarios.name: Answering that no region code is required asks for no code

tests.test: region code validation: No leaves the empty box unasked for
tests.notes: No with an empty box moves on to commodities: the code is not asked for; does not show the code is not saved or that submission goes through

tests.test: answering No clears a saved region code: the review shows Not applicable and Yes shows an empty box
tests.notes: No keeps no code (review shows Not applicable); starts from a saved code rather than one typed alongside No

tests.test: Should let a blank box through when the answer is No
Should clear the stored code when the answer changes from Yes to No

scenarios.notes: No test submits a notification answered No with no region code.

requirements.name: Answering that no region code is required clears a code already given

scenarios.name: The code is cleared when the answer changes to No

tests.test: answering No clears a saved region code: the review shows Not applicable and Yes shows an empty box
